summary: Switch dispatch on the unsigned value of a1: maps each input case group to a (write to *a2, write to *a3) combination and to one of a1/a2/a3 as the returned pointer. The dispatch uses the jump table jpt_4F803D (0x004F8114). Case group {1,4,7,0x16,0x2B}, {0xA,0x19} and default write (*a2=1, *a3=0) and return a3 or a2 respectively; the remaining case groups write (*a2=0, *a3=0) and return a3, a2, or the unchanged a1 depending on the group. Called from sub_4F70C0 (004F70C0).

local_names.a1: switch selector; its unsigned value selects the case group and, for some groups, the returned pointer
local_names.a2: output parameter written to 0 or 1; also the returned pointer for the default group and case group {0xC,0xF,0x12,0x1B,0x1E,0x21,0x24}
local_names.a3: output parameter written to 0 or 1; also the returned pointer for case groups {1,4,7,0x16,0x2B}, {0xA,0x19} and {0xD,0x10,0x13,0x1C,0x1F,0x22,0x25,0x28}
local_names.result: returned pointer; initialized to a1 and reassigned to a3 or a2 by specific case groups

operations.description: Switch on the unsigned value of a1, dispatched through the jump table jpt_4F803D (0x004F8114); each case group selects a write/return outcome, with the default group handling unmatched values
Write (*a2 = 1, *a3 = 0) for case groups {1,4,7,0x16,0x2B}, {2,5,8,0x17,0x2C}, {0xA,0x19}, {0xB,0x1A} and the default group

Return a3 for case groups {1,4,7,0x16,0x2B}, {0xA,0x19} and {0xD,0x10,0x13,0x1C,0x1F,0x22,0x25,0x28}; return a2 for case group {0xC,0xF,0x12,0x1B,0x1E,0x21,0x24} and the default group; otherwise return the unchanged a1
Invoked by sub_4F70C0 (004F70C0) to set the two output parameters according to the input selector
